PLAN "12-Week General Strength — L4-L5 Disc Herniation History"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength with spine-safe loading"

PHASES

  PHASE "Phase 1 — Foundation" (4 weeks):

    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Body A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          hip_abduction 2x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60s
          quad_stretch 60s
          pigeon_pose 60s

      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Body A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60s
          lat_stretch 60s
          shoulder_stretch 60s

      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
